llm_response.reason: The website shows multiple scam indicators: offers of gambling/slots with unlikely bonuses and guarantees, excessive urgency, fake discounts, numerous product categories mimicking real e-commerce, spoofing of a legitimate brand (Lazada), inconsistent branding (scatter Hitam), and apparent misuse/hijacking of a legitimate cultural domain. These are all typical scammers' tactics to deceive users into providing personal and financial information.
